findings.finding: No AWS Organization — a single-account estate
No OIDC provider — long-lived keys shared across two repositories
No Cognito user pool — identity is one shared passphrase
RDS backup retention 1 day, no Multi-AZ, no backup vault
The authorization engine gates nothing — two consumers, both navigational
34 of 35 audit writes bypass validation, redaction and chaining
No row provenance — seeded and operator-entered data are indistinguishable
One tenant's policy content compiled into the global engine
